gaps.explanation: Statement p4 Transfers in: General 25,000, Road Fund 849,110, Nonmajor 23,043, Total 897,153. Detail: General 25,000 (p5), Road 565,000 (p6 Road Fund budgetary schedule Actual), E911 13,043 (p13), Sheriff's Vehicle Sinking 10,000 (p14) = 613,043. The p4 Road Fund column evidently combines the Road Fund with the Roads - Bond Debt Service Fund (its 849,110 includes the 565,000 already in detail), while the bond fund's own budgetary schedule (p9) prints Transfers in Actual '-' (284,110 only in the budget columns). The only printed figure for the missing part is the Road Fund column total 849,110, whose money is partly inside the existing 565,000 line, so it cannot be added; 284,110 as a transfer in would be a derived remainder (849,110 - 565,000) and is not added. The report itself does not tie here (p4 vs p9); gap 284,110 stays. Transfers out (General (588,043), Road (284,110), County Fair (25,000) = (897,153)) are all in detail; Proceeds from Sale of Bonds print '-' in every column.
